ChangeServerConfirmBody: You will be signed out of {0}, and the copies StudyAtrium keeps on this device (widgets, Apple Watch, search) are removed. Your account and data on the server stay as they are.
HealthDesc: StudyAtrium can save finished focus rounds as Mindful Minutes and read sleep, heart rate variability, steps and cardio fitness (VO2max) to show them next to your study time. The data stays on this device.
HealthConnected: Connected. You can change what StudyAtrium may read or write in the Health app.
HealthDeclined: Access to Apple Health is turned off. To turn it on, open the Health app, tap your profile picture, choose Apps, then StudyAtrium.
LanguageFromSystemHint: StudyAtrium uses the language you set for it in the system settings.
